headline: Expanse Surges as Shelf and Mooring Reignite
war_summary: Since the midday edition the wires report quickening action in the north and west, with the Weathered Expanse now the liveliest desk. The Expanse logged eleven changes in two hours and forty-nine on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, standing six Warden to three Colonial with no neutral ground, after more than eleven thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand Warden casualties in the day and both loss rates accelerating. Fisherman's Row holds its tempo with eight changes in two hours and thirty-four on the day about Eidolo, Black Well and Arcadia, standing six Colonial, one Warden and two neutral, its latest turn minutes before filing. Stlican Shelf has stirred anew with five changes in two hours and twenty-seven on the day about the Old Mourn and Pale House, latest at the hour of filing, standing seven Warden, one Colonial and one neutral. Mooring County shows four changes in two hours at Wiccwalk after a quiet morning, with Marban Hollow adding three in six hours about Mox, while Callahan's Passage and Farranac Coast show no change in two hours and their neutrals cleared, and Stonecradle rests with twelve changes on the day but none in six hours.
